name: Fattura24
description:
Connect your Fattura24 account to Claude and query your business management and accounting data in natural language, without opening reports, navigating between sections, or building analyses manually.

If you use Fattura24, you already have all the data you need: revenue, collections, payments, VAT, and margins. 
The problem is that using it takes time. 
With the MCP connector, that part disappears: ask a question and get the analysis.

What you can ask Claude:
1) Monthly revenue and year-over-year comparisons, with seasonal trends
2) Unpaid invoices, collections, and payments with receivables aging
3) Sales by product/service and geographic distribution
4) Trial balance: revenue, fixed costs, variable costs, contribution margin, and EBITDA
5) Comparison between actuals and budget (forecast)
6) Ready-to-use summaries for the board, accountant, or operational meetings.

Practical examples:
"Show me monthly revenue for 2024, 2025, and 2026 side by side. Does the seasonal peak always fall in the same month?"

"Which invoices are unpaid? Give me a follow-up priority by amount and aging."

"Prepare a first-quarter summary for the board: headline KPIs, revenue trend, product mix, and three points to watch."
Read-only — no installation

The connector reads your data; it does not modify it. It does not create invoices, send documents to the SDI, or touch master data records. Access is handled through OAuth: you authenticate with Fattura24 and authorize the connection. 

You can revoke access at any time.
Available to all Fattura24 users with an active subscription.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Fattura24 to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Fattura24 to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://www.app.fattura24.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Fattura24 MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Fattura24 lists 16 MCP tools, including account_consumi_mcp, account_dettagli, download_esito_sdi, report_analisi_iva, report_area_geografica, report_bilancino, report_churn_rate, report_fatturato, report_fatturato_confronto, report_forecast, report_pagamenti_confronto, and report_pareto.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Fattura24?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Fattura24 in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Fattura24 requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Fattura24 is developed by Fattura24 Srl. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
